"This guy has a risk appetite and resources that some people underestimate, given the miserable performance of Russia at the battlefield." Russia expert @AlexGabuev played Vladimir Putin in a German war game. He tells me it was a "very sad feeling," impersonating the man destroying Ukraine.

Video

“There is absolutely zero evidence that Vladimir Putin is ready to change course.” Expert @AlexGabuev tells me that dissatisfaction is growing in Russia, but it won’t lead to any change in Putin’s course over Ukraine.

“I see a hollowing out of the Geneva Conventions,” warns @ICRC president Mirjana Spoljaric. “Civilians are systematically reduced to numbers and statistics. We are losing sight of humanity, which has to be put at the center of all of this. 

“We cannot accept the levels of destruction. We cannot accept the levels of suffering anymore. The numbers of casualties and displaced people and the rhetoric – the rhetoric around this is most problematic because it lowers the barriers. It lowers the moral

.@ICRC President Mirjana Spoljaric just returned from Iran, where she saw the war’s destruction firsthand and met government officials. 

All warring parties, she says, “are bound by the Geneva Conventions in the event of conflict. You have to spare the lives of your adversary of the people living in the neighboring countries, in the region, anywhere in the world. But you also have to protect civilian life in your own country at all levels, under all conditions.”

Video

I was so moved watching this back, 11 years later, hearing Ted's wisdom and sense of honor. I've never had a better boss.

“I figured if I get on the air, and people see just how helpful it's gonna be, I'll be able to raise the money later on. And I was able to do just exactly that.” I talked to Ted Turner about the white-knuckle early days of CNN. This titan of industry and philanthropy will be greatly missed.

Video

Just Remember when Giants Strode the World. 

Ted Turner created an unstoppable media revolution for the BENEFIT of all humankind.

Throughout nearly 43 years at CNN, working for Ted and his vision has been the proudest achievement of my lifetime.

RIP

It’s been a royal affair in Washington, DC this week as King Charles III made his first US state visit. We wrap up some of the highlights of a trip that capitalized on America’s enduring fascination with Britain’s royals.

This weekend marks World Press Freedom day, but there’s little to celebrate as those freedoms are threatened. From my archives, I saw exactly what it looks like when the media is under attack in Moscow in 2007, where Russian journalists were living in fear.

As Israeli settlers continue to attack Palestinians across the occupied West Bank. CNN Producer Abeer Salman reports from Umm al-Khair, where razor wire has blocked Palestinian children from going to school.

"For two hours, she recounted in unflinching details the horrors of the camp. She detailed everything she had seen in Auschwitz- the fate of babies, the fate of children, the fate of women. She spoke of sexual violence. And she was determined to restore names to those who had been reduced to numbers and then to ash."

Best-selling author Natalie Livingstone on the extraordinary story of Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier whose testimony at Nuremberg changed the course of history.

"Nuremberg is so much more than just courtroom 600, where the trial took place. It was a big ecosystem that comprised of so many women who were there in so many vital roles- translators, witnesses, journalists, artists, lawyers... for some reason these women were marginalized and got sidelined and literally reduced to footnotes in history."

The Nuremberg trials have been well documented, but one vital piece of that story has been missing all these years.

What’s happening in Haiti is a massively underreported story, a state near total collapse.
